gabriel_garcia_marquez.name: Gabriel García Márquez
gabriel_garcia_marquez.description: Colombian novelist, Nobel Prize winner, magical realism pioneer. Major works include One Hundred Years of Solitude, Love in the Time of Cholera. Themes: solitude, time, memory, Latin American identity, cyclical history, magical realism techniques.

clarice_lispector.name: Clarice Lispector
clarice_lispector.description: Brazilian novelist, modernist, existentialist. Known for introspective prose and exploration of the self. Major works include The Hour of the Star, The Passion According to G.H. Themes: identity, existence, the inner self.

edouard_glissant.name: Édouard Glissant
edouard_glissant.description: Martinican poet, novelist, and essayist. Major works include The Poetics of Relation, and The Overcoming of History. Themes: identity, history, and the Caribbean experience.

alejandra_pizarnik.name: Alejandra Pizarnik
alejandra_pizarnik.description: Argentinian poet and writer known for her intense and lyrical poetry. Major works include Works and Nights and Extracting the Stone of Madness. Themes: solitude, existentialism, the search for identity.

jorge_luis_borges.name: Jorge Luis Borges
jorge_luis_borges.description: Argentinian writer, poet, and essayist. Known for his intricate short stories and philosophical themes. Major works include Ficciones, Labyrinths, and The Aleph. Themes: infinity, labyrinths, identity, reality.

anne_carson.name: Anne Carson
anne_carson.description: Canadian poet, essayist, and translator. Known for her innovative and genre-defying works. Major works include Autobiography of Red and The Beauty of the Husband. Themes: love, loss, mythology, the nature of art.

roberto_bolano.name: Roberto Bolaño
roberto_bolano.description: Chilean novelist, poet, and essayist. Known for his complex narratives and exploration of the human condition. Major works include The Savage Detectives and 2666. Themes: violence, memory, the search for meaning.

maryse_conde.name: Maryse Condé
maryse_conde.description: Guadeloupean author known for her novels and essays exploring the complexities of Caribbean identity and history. Major works include Windward Heights and The Story of the Cannibal Woman. Themes: identity, colonialism, feminism.

marcel_schwob.name: Marcel Schwob
marcel_schwob.description: French symbolist writer known for his short stories and innovative narrative techniques. Major works include The Book of Monelle and Imaginary Lives. Themes: identity, transformation, the uncanny.

toni_morrison.name: Toni Morrison
toni_morrison.description: American novelist, Nobel Prize winner. Major works include Beloved, Song of Solomon. Themes: African-American identity, history, racism.

chimamanda_ngozi_adichie.name: Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie
chimamanda_ngozi_adichie.description: Nigerian novelist and feminist. Major works include Purple Hibiscus, Half of a Yellow Sun. Themes: colonialism, feminism, cultural identity.

salman_rushdie.name: Salman Rushdie
salman_rushdie.description: British-Indian novelist. Major works include Midnight's Children, The Satanic Verses. Themes: post-colonialism, migration, hybrid identity.

margaret_atwood.name: Margaret Atwood
margaret_atwood.description: Canadian novelist and poet. Major works include The Handmaid's Tale, Oryx and Crake. Themes: feminism, dystopia, environmentalism.

arundhati_roy.name: Arundhati Roy
arundhati_roy.description: Indian author and activist. Major works include The God of Small Things. Themes: caste system, post-colonialism, political activism.

yukio_mishima.name: Yukio Mishima
yukio_mishima.description: Japanese novelist, poet, playwright. Major works include The Temple of the Golden Pavilion, Confessions of a Mask. Themes: beauty, death, traditionalism vs modernity.

isabel_allende.name: Isabel Allende
isabel_allende.description: Chilean novelist. Major works include The House of the Spirits, Eva Luna. Themes: magical realism, family sagas, political turmoil.

assia_djebar.name: Assia Djebar
assia_djebar.description: Algerian novelist and historian. Major works include Fantasia: An Algerian Cavalcade, Women of Algiers in Their Apartment. Themes: feminism, colonialism, Algerian history.

kazuo_ishiguro.name: Kazuo Ishiguro
kazuo_ishiguro.description: British novelist of Japanese origin. Major works include The Remains of the Day, Never Let Me Go. Themes: memory, identity, historical amnesia.

zadie_smith.name: Zadie Smith
zadie_smith.description: British novelist. Major works include White Teeth, NW. Themes: multiculturalism, identity, urban life.

orhan_pamuk.name: Orhan Pamuk
orhan_pamuk.description: Turkish novelist and Nobel Prize winner. Major works include My Name Is Red, Snow. Themes: East-West divide, identity, art and religion.

gao_xingjian.name: Gao Xingjian
gao_xingjian.description: Chinese-French novelist, playwright, critic, and Nobel Prize winner. Major works include Soul Mountain, One Man's Bible. Themes: existentialism, identity, exile.

ocean_vuong.name: Ocean Vuong
ocean_vuong.description: Vietnamese-American poet, essayist, and novelist. Major works include Night Sky with Exit Wounds, On Earth We're Briefly Gorgeous. Themes: immigration, identity, trauma.

ts_eliot.name: T.S. Eliot
ts_eliot.description: American-British poet, essayist, and playwright. Major works include The Waste Land, Four Quartets. Themes: modernism, time, spirituality.

william_shakespeare.name: William Shakespeare
william_shakespeare.description: English playwright and poet. Major works include Hamlet, Romeo and Juliet, Macbeth. Themes: love, power, betrayal, fate, identity.

leo_tolstoy.name: Leo Tolstoy
leo_tolstoy.description: Russian novelist and moral philosopher. Major works include War and Peace, Anna Karenina. Themes: morality, war, family, society, spirituality.

fyodor_dostoevsky.name: Fyodor Dostoevsky
fyodor_dostoevsky.description: Russian novelist and philosopher. Major works include Crime and Punishment, The Brothers Karamazov. Themes: psychology, faith, guilt, redemption, existentialism.

jane_austen.name: Jane Austen
jane_austen.description: English novelist. Major works include Pride and Prejudice, Emma, Sense and Sensibility. Themes: love, class, marriage, society, gender roles.

charles_dickens.name: Charles Dickens
charles_dickens.description: English novelist and social critic. Major works include Great Expectations, Oliver Twist, A Tale of Two Cities. Themes: poverty, justice, childhood, society, redemption.

virginia_woolf.name: Virginia Woolf
virginia_woolf.description: English modernist writer. Major works include Mrs Dalloway, To the Lighthouse, Orlando. Themes: time, consciousness, gender, identity, mental health.

franz_kafka.name: Franz Kafka
franz_kafka.description: Czech novelist and short story writer. Major works include The Metamorphosis, The Trial, The Castle. Themes: alienation, bureaucracy, absurdity, identity, existentialism.

emily_dickinson.name: Emily Dickinson
emily_dickinson.description: American poet. Major works include Because I could not stop for Death, I heard a Fly buzz—when I died. Themes: death, nature, love, isolation, immortality.

homer.name: Homer
homer.description: Ancient Greek epic poet. Major works include The Iliad, The Odyssey. Themes: heroism, fate, war, journey, honor.

dante_alighieri.name: Dante Alighieri
dante_alighieri.description: Italian poet. Major works include The Divine Comedy. Themes: sin, redemption, love, faith, journey.

george_orwell.name: George Orwell
george_orwell.description: English novelist, essayist, and critic. Major works include 1984, Animal Farm. Themes: totalitarianism, freedom, truth, power, dystopia.

h_g_wells.name: H.G. Wells
h_g_wells.description: English writer. Major works include The War of the Worlds, The Time Machine, The Invisible Man. Themes: science, future, society, evolution, ethics.

oscar_wilde.name: Oscar Wilde
oscar_wilde.description: Irish playwright, poet, and novelist. Major works include The Picture of Dorian Gray, The Importance of Being Earnest. Themes: beauty, art, morality, society, wit.

ernest_hemingway.name: Ernest Hemingway
ernest_hemingway.description: American novelist and short story writer. Major works include The Old Man and the Sea, A Farewell to Arms, For Whom the Bell Tolls. Themes: courage, war, loss, masculinity, nature.

mark_twain.name: Mark Twain
mark_twain.description: American novelist and humorist. Major works include Adventures of Huckleberry Finn, The Adventures of Tom Sawyer. Themes: childhood, freedom, race, society, adventure.

james_joyce.name: James Joyce
james_joyce.description: Irish novelist and poet. Major works include Ulysses, Dubliners, A Portrait of the Artist as a Young Man. Themes: identity, time, consciousness, exile, language.

marcel_proust.name: Marcel Proust
marcel_proust.description: French novelist. Major works include In Search of Lost Time. Themes: memory, time, love, society, art.

j_r_r_tolkien.name: J.R.R. Tolkien
j_r_r_tolkien.description: English writer, philologist, and academic. Major works include The Lord of the Rings, The Hobbit, The Silmarillion. Themes: heroism, mythology, good vs evil, friendship, journey.

haruki_murakami.name: Haruki Murakami
haruki_murakami.description: Japanese novelist and translator. Major works include Norwegian Wood, Kafka on the Shore, 1Q84. Themes: loneliness, surrealism, love, memory, identity.

john_steinbeck.name: John Steinbeck
john_steinbeck.description: American novelist. Major works include The Grapes of Wrath, Of Mice and Men, East of Eden. Themes: poverty, family, justice, nature, society.

maya_angelou.name: Maya Angelou
maya_angelou.description: American poet, memoirist, and civil rights activist. Major works include I Know Why the Caged Bird Sings. Themes: identity, racism, resilience, family, freedom.

j_d_salinger.name: J.D. Salinger
j_d_salinger.description: American novelist and short story writer. Major works include The Catcher in the Rye, Nine Stories. Themes: alienation, innocence, youth, society, identity.
